replication.target_description: Study 1: postextinction L-DOPA versus placebo effect on day-3 spontaneous recovery in extinction context B; stimulus by group ANOVA interaction.

n.sample_role: Male participants with available valid day-3 SCR data in the target ANOVA
n.exclusions: Methods reports day-3 SCR data unavailable for 15 participants: 12 invalid for over 75% zero-response trials and 3 unavailable data; no imaging exclusions applied to this behavioral ANOVA.
n.location: Results, Effect of L-DOPA administration post extinction on extinction memory retrieval

es.location: Results, Effect of L-DOPA administration post extinction on extinction memory retrieval, hypothesis 1, spontaneous recovery; Methods, Sample size (assigned locator p. 4; canonical HTML text unpaginated).
es.quote: Contrary to our predictions, administration of L-DOPA on day 2 did not result in a statistically significant reduction of spontaneous recovery on day 3 (averaged CRs across all trials; stimulus: F 1,53 = 55.30, p < 0.001, generalized η 2 = 0.20; group: F 1,53 = 0.91, p = 0.344; stimulus*group: F 1,53 = 0.02, p = 0.887; n = 55).

p.location: Results, Effect of L-DOPA administration post extinction on extinction memory retrieval

reported_success.quote: We could not replicate the facilitating effect of L-DOPA on extinction retrieval (hypothesis 1) and on the number of vmPFC reactivations (hypothesis 3).

notes:
HTML section headings identify the tests precisely; PDF pagination not independently verified. Replication prints no effect-size metric for the target stimulus-by-group interaction; its F statistic is retained in test_statistic. Generalized eta squared 0.20 belongs to the stimulus main effect, not the interaction, and is not extracted.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Methods explicitly identify the stimulus-by-group interaction on day-3 extinction-context retrieval as the main effect of interest; Results print its F statistic. Requested metric is test statistic, so F is retained.
